text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Here it comes! This year's Arima is incredible!
The three most-watched racers are all lined up!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Now, it begins! This year's "Arima Kinen"!
Who will conquer this dream showdown?!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: "First, the uncrowned king of the Classic class! Hailing from regional racing, she didn't run the Triple Crown, but her skill is second to none!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I can't lose.
—For everyone back home, too.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Next is the Senior division's absolute champion.
The little white giant who claimed back-to-back GⅠ victories.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, time for some Naniwa guts!
I'm gonna take 'em all on and wipe the floor with 'em~!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
And lastly, the late-blooming superstar,
who has walked hand in hand with their rookie trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, come on, let's go up on the podium together.
No need to be so shy~."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, take this seriously!
That's it, we're done. Alright, dismissed~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu, we got laughed at earlier, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
“Still, this race marks the end of a year filled with worries.
I'll run it without any regrets.”

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: "Yes. Tama-chan was worried about all sorts of things before we got here, after all."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to pay you back properly.
With the best race of my life♪
